description: Food type definitions for the Snake Arena. Spawn probabilities are normalized at load time if they do not sum to 1. Lifetime is a [min, max] range in seconds, converted to game ticks using the current moves-per-second rate.

types.name: normal
types.description: Standard food. Low risk, modest reward.

types.name: bonus
types.description: Medium reward, expires faster than normal food.

types.name: golden
types.description: High reward, short lifetime: reward/pursuit trade-off.

types.name: special
types.description: Very high reward, very short lifetime, grows the snake by 2.

types.name: trap
types.description: Penalty food: -20 points on collection, no growth. Smart agents learn to route around it.
